reconciliation.draftSaved: Draft saved. An independent reviewer can confirm it.
reconciliation.suggestionRejected: Suggestion rejected. No balances were changed.
reconciliation.saveError: Could not save. Check your permissions and refresh balances before trying again.
reconciliation.confirmedNotice: Reconciliation confirmed and recorded in this application's history.
reconciliation.reviewError: Review could not be completed. Balances may have changed or you may lack permission for some units. Refresh and review again.
reconciliation.title: Bank reconciliation
reconciliation.description: From bank movement to financial record. Check the source, allocate the amount, and review the decision.
reconciliation.noEntries: No entries match this filter. Try another tab or search.
reconciliation.identityDescription: No matching reference, tax ID or name was found. An equal amount alone does not allow confirmation. Keep the deposit pending.
reconciliation.sourceOverlapDescription: Protheus and Omie records have matching identities and amounts. They are distinct records: check the source before allocating.
reconciliation.selectCreditHint: Select a credit on the left to allocate the receipt.
reconciliation.noTitles: No financial records found. Adjust the search or source system.
reconciliation.amountsHint: Use positive amounts with up to two decimal places, without exceeding the credit balance or each record's balance.
reconciliation.ownDraft: You proposed this draft. Confirmation requires another authorized reviewer.
reconciliation.reviewerHint: Save the allocations; another authorized reviewer must verify identity and confirm.
reconciliation.localRecord: Local record · no writes to Itaú, Protheus or Omie.
reconciliation.discardDescription: Switching credits will discard the allocations being edited. Go back to save the draft before continuing.
reconciliation.confirmDescription: The decision will be audited in this application. No writes will be made to source systems.
reconciliation.overlapHint: Check that the records represent distinct obligations.
reconciliation.detailsDescription: Viewing details preserves the credit and allocations being edited.
reconciliation.author: {date} · author {id}

imports.title: Data imports
imports.description: Bring your financial data together. Upload a file, match its columns, and review every record.
imports.uploadStepDescription: CSV and XLSX, including Omie, Protheus, and Itaú formats.
imports.mappingStepDescription: Check columns, business units, and number formats before importing.
imports.exceptionsStepDescription: Track accepted records and correct individual rejected rows.
imports.historyDescription: Files visible to your account and business-unit scope.
imports.emptyCanImport: Choose New import to upload a CSV or spreadsheet. You can review the mapping before processing.
imports.emptyNoPermission: No imports are visible yet. Ask your administrator for import permissions if you need to upload a file.
imports.uploadDescription: Preview your file and review its columns. Nothing is saved until you choose Confirm and import.
imports.datasetHint: Protheus and Omie are detected as receivables; Itaú as bank statements. This selection applies to other file formats.
imports.fileValidation: Choose a nonempty CSV or XLSX file up to 100 MiB, with a filename of 200 characters or fewer.
imports.fileHint: CSV or XLSX · up to 100 MiB. The first row must contain unique column names.
imports.unavailableDescription: This import could not be found. If you refreshed before confirming, your preview was discarded. Return to imports and select your file again.
imports.discardDescription: Leaving discards this preview. Your file and mapping won't be saved.
imports.leaveDescription: Confirmed imports remain saved. If processing is unfinished, it resumes when you return to this import.
imports.preparationDescription: Retry reading the saved original. If the upload never finished, return to imports and upload the file again.
imports.processingProgress: {processed, number} of {total, number} records processed · {percent, number}%
imports.automaticProcessing: Importing automatically. Keep this page open; if you leave, processing resumes when you return.
imports.correctionsNeeded: {count, plural, one {# record needs correction.} other {# records need correction.}} Save your changes below; corrected records are imported automatically.
imports.allAccepted: All records were accepted. Your imported data is ready.
imports.mappingDescription: Match your source columns to financial fields. Required fields are marked with *.
imports.sharedStatementHint: Select one or more units. Each movement is imported once and shares a single balance.
imports.visibleUnitsHint: Only units visible to your account are listed.
imports.automaticUnitsHint: Protheus unit names are matched automatically. New units are registered if your permissions allow it.
imports.unitNamesHint: Enter every distinct value from the mapped unit column, separated by commas.
imports.bankAccountHint: Select an active account linked to every selected unit, in the selected currency.
imports.confirmHint: Confirming locks the mapping. You can correct individual rejected rows after processing.
imports.correctRowDescription: Edit the source values and return this row to the processing queue.
imports.sourceRecordsDescription: Inspect source values and correct rejected records. Saved corrections are imported automatically.

ui.unitsHint: Select one or more units. Changing units clears selected bank accounts.
ui.accountsHint: Only accounts in your scope can be assigned. Removing units may require clearing dependent approval scopes first.
ui.cannotManageDestinations: Contact your workspace administrator to manage destinations.
